AIInsights.description: The AI resume review, made with the visitor's own key and saved on the resume.
AIInsights.title: AIInsights

AIKeyCheckIn.description: A visitor's provider and key to check. The key is used once and never saved.
AIKeyCheckIn.title: AIKeyCheckIn

AIKeyCheckOut.description: The chat models this key can use plus the one we suggest picking.
AIKeyCheckOut.title: AIKeyCheckOut

AlignCheck.description: One yes or no check, like "Your program is one it asks for".
AlignCheck.title: AlignCheck

ApplicationEventOut.description: One entry in a saved job's status history.
ApplicationEventOut.title: ApplicationEventOut

ApplicationStatus.description:
The stages a co-op application goes through.
The str mixin lets FastAPI send these as plain strings.
NULL in the database means no status yet, which is not the same as any value here.
ApplicationStatus.title: ApplicationStatus

AskRequest.description:
mode "question"      answers `question` with sources and needs a question
mode "tailor"        says how to tailor this resume for the job
mode "cover_letter"  writes a short cover letter opening for the job
AskRequest.title: AskRequest

CategoryCount.description: A job type for the filter list with how many open jobs it has.
CategoryCount.title: CategoryCount

ChangePasswordIn.description: Change password body. The new one follows the same rules as sign up.
ChangePasswordIn.title: ChangePasswordIn

DeleteAccountIn.description: Delete account body. Asks for the password so nobody deletes by accident.
DeleteAccountIn.title: DeleteAccountIn

DemandSkill.description: A skill employers ask for and how many open jobs ask for it.
DemandSkill.title: DemandSkill

DetectedEducation.description: What we read from the education part of the resume. Blank when we could not find it.
DetectedEducation.title: DetectedEducation

EventCreateIn.description: Body for POST /api/saved/{id}/events. Logs a status change with an optional note.
EventCreateIn.title: EventCreateIn

FilterMeta.description:
The choices for each filter menu.
They come from the jobs table so the site never offers a city
that has no jobs.
FilterMeta.title: FilterMeta

IngestRunOut.description: One import run as we send it out.
IngestRunOut.title: IngestRunOut

IngestSourceOut.description: An import source as we send it out.
IngestSourceOut.title: IngestSourceOut

JobPreferences.description:
What the student is looking for, set before or after uploading. Matching only looks at
open jobs that fit these. Keywords like "data analyst" push fitting jobs higher.
JobPreferences.title: JobPreferences

LoginIn.description: Sign in body. No length rule here so a wrong password gets 401 and not 422.
LoginIn.title: LoginIn

ManualPostingIn.description: A job someone adds by hand through POST /api/postings.
ManualPostingIn.title: ManualPostingIn

PostingDetail.description: Everything about one job, description included.
PostingDetail.title: PostingDetail

PostingListItem.description:
One job in the list.
Leaves out the description to keep lists small.
PostingListItem.title: PostingListItem

PostingsSnapshot.description:
The first page of the jobs page as nobody has filtered it yet, plus the filter choices.
It is the same for every visitor, so the CDN in front of the site can keep a copy and show
it at once, even while a sleeping free server is still waking up.
PostingsSnapshot.title: PostingsSnapshot

PublicConfig.description: What the site should show. Never any secrets, just which features are on.
PublicConfig.title: PublicConfig

RegisterIn.description: Sign up body. The email has to look real and the password needs 10 or more characters.
RegisterIn.title: RegisterIn

ResumeAlignment.description: How to make the saved resume fit one job. Free and with no AI.
ResumeAlignment.title: ResumeAlignment

ResumeInsights.description: Free insights that are always there plus the AI review, which is None until asked for.
ResumeInsights.title: ResumeInsights

RowError.description: One problem with one row of a CSV upload.
RowError.title: RowError

SaveIn.description: Body for POST /api/saved. Just the id of the job to save.
SaveIn.title: SaveIn

SavedPostingOut.description:
A saved job with the whole posting inside it.
GET /api/saved items and the POST and PATCH calls send this back.
SavedPostingOut.title: SavedPostingOut

SavedPostingsPage.description: A page of saved jobs with a count for each status.
SavedPostingsPage.title: SavedPostingsPage

SimilarPostingOut.description: One job in the similar jobs list.
SimilarPostingOut.title: SimilarPostingOut

SourcePatchIn.description: What you can change on a source. Everything is optional.
SourcePatchIn.title: SourcePatchIn

StatusUpdateIn.description: Body for PATCH /api/saved/{id}/status. Send null to clear the status.
StatusUpdateIn.title: StatusUpdateIn

UserOut.description: The user we send back. Never has hashed_password in it.
UserOut.title: UserOut

WorkMode.description:
Saved as a Postgres ENUM called work_mode_enum so the database
itself rejects bad values.
The str mixin lets FastAPI send it as a plain string.
WorkMode.title: WorkMode

info.description: Co-op jobs from real employers. Browse, search, save, track and match your resume.
info.title: CoopRadar API

get.description: List every source with how its last run went.

schema.title: Response Get Sources Api Admin Sources Get

patch.description: Turn a source on or off, or unpause it.

post.description: Run a source right now. Answers 409 if it is already running.

get.description: Run history for one source, a page at a time.

post.description: Ask the provider if the key works. 400 AI_KEY_INVALID if not and 429 when over the limit.

Try the demo makes a private demo account with sample data and signs into it.
Answers 404 DEMO_DISABLED when DEMO_ENABLED is false and 429 after 10 per IP an hour.

Use CoopRadar without signing up. Makes an empty temporary account that lasts 7 days.
You can keep it for good later with POST /api/me/claim.

Check the email and password and sign in.
Wrong email and wrong password get the exact same 401 message on purpose.
End the session right away and clear the cookie.

Make a new account and sign in.
Answers 409 if the email is already taken.

get.description: Feature switches for the site. Never any secrets, just whether things are on.
Health check for the host and CI. It never touches the database.

delete.description:
Delete the account and everything tied to it for good, like saved jobs and statuses.
The database cascade does the cleanup. Answers 401 if the password is wrong.

get.description: Give back the signed in person's profile.

post.description:
Keep a temporary or demo account by adding an email and password. Saved jobs, the resume
and matches all stay. 400 ALREADY_CLAIMED for normal accounts and 409 EMAIL_TAKEN if in use.

patch.description:
Change your password.
Answers 401 if the current password is wrong and 422 if the new one is under 10 characters.

get.description:
List jobs with search, filters, sorting and pages.
FastAPI checks every query param against PostingListParams so a sort column or
page size we do not allow is a 422 before the service even runs.
Signed in people also get is_saved on each job.

post.description: Add one job by hand. Answers 409 if it is already there.

get.description:
An RSS feed of the newest jobs for a search. Takes the same filters as GET /api/postings and
always gives the 50 jobs we added most recently, so feed readers pick up new ones.

The choices for the filter menus like cities, provinces, terms and skills.
The site caches this for 5 minutes since it only changes when new jobs come in.

The first page of jobs and the filter choices in one reply that is the same for everyone,
so it can be cached. The site shows it the moment the page opens, then swaps in the
visitor's own list (with saved jobs marked) when that arrives.

post.description:
Import a bunch of jobs from a CSV file.
Limited to 3 uploads per person per hour.

get.description: Everything about one job. Answers 404 if the id is not there.
Up to 5 jobs that are most alike by embedding.

delete.description: Delete the resume and every match for good.

get.description: Details about the saved resume for the signed in person.

post.description:
Upload a resume as PDF or DOCX up to 5 MB, read the text, match it and save
and return the ranked matches. With the visitor's own AI key the AI ranks and
explains the matches. With no key at all we rank by skill overlap for free.
Only the owner's backup key counts toward the daily AI limit.
`preferences` is optional JSON for what the student is looking for.

get.description:
How to make the saved resume fit one job. Skills and words it has or lacks, plain checks
and the edits to make. No AI, so it is free and instant. 404 with no resume or job.
Skills we found and popular skills you are missing for free, plus the saved AI review.

post.description: Run the AI resume review on the visitor's key and save it.

get.description: Saved ranked matches. An empty list if there is no resume yet.

post.description:
Stream an answer with sources about one matched job.
It is a text/event-stream of small pieces that ends with [DONE].

put.description:
Save what the student wants like job type, place, work mode, level and keywords
and match the saved resume again. Uses their own AI key if they set one
and the free ranking if not, so changing filters never spends the owner's AI quota.

post.description: Rank the saved resume against today's jobs again with the visitor's AI.

get.description:
Your saved jobs plus status counts, deadlines and stats.
You can filter by status. Newest saves come first.

post.description:
Save a job. Safe to repeat. Answers 201 the first time and 200 after that.
Answers 404 if the job does not exist.

get.description:
Download your whole tracker as a CSV file.
Built on the server with pandas and sent straight to the browser.

delete.description: Unsave a job. Answers 404 if it is not there or belongs to someone else.

post.description:
Add a status event by hand, like noting an interview date after the fact.
This also changes the current status on the saved job.

patch.description:
Change the application status on a saved job and log the change.
Send null to clear it. Answers 404 if it is not there or belongs to someone else.
